reviews.name: Xiaoxiao
reviews.title: Great idea for a kid product
reviews.body: My kid loves this and calls him “toothpaste guy”. It makes squeezing toothpaste easier and motivates her to brush teeth. She then puts her toothbrush in the “hat”. I’m giving 4 stars because there are some areas this product could use improvement. One is that it’s wobbly when you attach the bottom (tends to fall backwards so currently we take the bottom off and just use the top half for the dispensing function. Second is that there’s no way to clean the inside of the “mouth” after toothpaste spills (the toothbrush might not catch all the toothpaste that comes out). Currently I just rinse with water but it’s not going to clean completely. I think this is a great idea and a great product. Could use some additional design comportment.
